features.name: Hunt Domain Spells
features.description:
| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | bloodbound, illuminate spoor |
| 3rd | instant snare, mark prey |
| 5th | going in circles, tracer |
| 7th | heart-seeking arrow, hunting stand |
| 9th | harrying hounds, maim |

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with martial weapons.

features.name: Blessing of the Hunter
features.description: At 1st level, you gain proficiency in Survival. As an action, touch a willing creature other than yourself to grant it advantage on WIS (Survival) checks for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

payload.name: Blessing of the Hunter
payload.description: Touch a willing creature: advantage on Survival checks for 1 hour (or until used again).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Heart Strike
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, use Channel Divinity to add +5 to the attack's damage. On a critical hit, add +10 instead.

features.name: Pack Hunter
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when an ally within 30 feet makes a weapon attack roll against a creature you attacked this round, you can use your reaction to grant that ally advantage on the attack roll.

payload.name: Pack Hunter
payload.description: When an ally within 30 ft attacks a creature you attacked this round, grant them advantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type. Increases to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Deadly Stalker
features.description: At 17th level, as an action, describe or name a familiar creature or one within 120 ft. For 24 hours or until it dies: advantage on Survival checks to track it, advantage on Perception checks to detect it, and advantage on weapon attack rolls against it. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Deadly Stalker
payload.description: Designate a target for 24 hours: advantage on Survival/Perception checks and weapon attack rolls against it.
